description: Create a sandbox (omit templateId) or change one. A definition is Dockerfile steps on the platform base (RUN, ENV, ARG, WORKDIR, USER; no FROM). A changed definition or size becomes a new version and is built at once; the response carries that build. Refusals name the line or the size bound.

dockerfile.description: The Dockerfile that builds the sandbox image. Give this or starterId to create; it replaces the file on an update

size.description: A tier, or { vcpu, memoryMib, diskMb } within 1-4 vCPU, >=3072 MiB per vCPU, <=12288 MiB, 8000-20000 MB

starterId.description: Create from a starter's definition and size

name: save_sandbox_template
title: Create or update a sandbox
